name: confluencr-ledger
description: Multi-tenant ledger API and console: accounts, immutable transactions, atomic transfers and organization RBAC

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run env:setup && npm run seed
scripts.dev: npm --prefix backend run dev & npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
